approvals.scope: create additive generation metadata, transaction, aggregate, coverage, and pointer objects
approvals.stop_point: stop before any production schema statement
approvals.required_evidence: reviewed forward migration, rollback-safe schema review, PostgreSQL integration tests, and operator approval

approvals.scope: register an inactive generation and load authoritative generation-scoped transaction rows
approvals.stop_point: stop before generation registration or first candidate batch
approvals.required_evidence: approval A completed, manifest frozen, loader dry run passed, capacity reviewed, and write owner approval

approvals.scope: build generation-scoped aggregates and coverage from the inactive authoritative candidate
approvals.stop_point: stop before any candidate aggregate write
approvals.required_evidence: candidate transaction gates passed and aggregate owner approval

approvals.scope: atomically move the active generation pointer after shadow comparison
approvals.stop_point: stop before locking or updating the active pointer
approvals.required_evidence: all hard gates passed, rollback rehearsed, blue-green comparison accepted, incident owner present, and read-switch approval

approvals.scope: retire or delete legacy data only in a separate later phase after retention review
approvals.stop_point: stop before retirement flag or any legacy deletion
approvals.required_evidence: completed observation period, backup and audit retention confirmed, separate change request, and deletion-specific approval
